cands.name: Lisette Bonano
cands.bio: Retired Army Lieutenant Colonel (28 years; Pentagon, Iraq and Afghanistan service per her site), educator and self-described constitutional conservative. Running for HD 67 for the third time (lost in 2022 and 2024); has never held elected office.
cands.local_ties: Hillsborough County (DOE filing county); her site frames the campaign around Tampa Bay.

record.text: No elected office. Lost this seat's 2022 general election (by about 8 points) and the 2024 GOP primary (by 13 points), per Florida Politics.

money_notes.text: Had raised less than $7,000 as of Sept. 4, 2026.

controversies.text: Her Division of Elections file lists multiple 'failure to file' letters and assessed fines for late campaign finance reports, per Florida Politics.

cands.gaps: No endorsements or photo found. Her site has an Endorsements page I could not read. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

money.note: Includes primary and general. 'State of Florida' lines are public matching funds; party-committee lines are mostly in-kind staff and mail.

qual.background: Retired Army lieutenant colonel (28 years, Pentagon, Iraq, Afghanistan); educator; third run.

cands.name: Luis Viera
cands.bio: Tampa lawyer and Democrat; Tampa City Council member for District 7 (New Tampa/north Tampa) who resigned effective Nov. 2 under Florida's resign-to-run law. Former HART board chair; founder of the Lawyers Autism Awareness Foundation.
cands.local_ties: Lifelong Tampa resident, 'proud son of refugees'; says he grew up in the district's communities (campaign site and resignation letter, per Florida Politics).

record.text: As council member: secured funding for three fire stations, led the apprenticeship ordinance, pushed the Tenant's Bill of Rights and a returning-citizens ordinance, All Abilities parks, $3.2 million in post-hurricane housing assistance; chaired HART's board three terms and the council Public Safety Committee. His council start year is reported inconsistently by Florida Politics (2016 vs 2019).

money_notes.text: Raised more than $184,000 through his campaign account (about $5,000 on hand Oct. 16); affiliated committee Fair Deal Florida has about $21,000.

endorsements.text: House Democratic Leader Fentrice Driskell and Rep. Kathy Castor.
Tampa PBA, West Central Florida PBA, Sun Coast PBA, Hillsborough Firefighters Local 2294, Tampa Firefighters Local 754.
Florida Realtors PAC; Florida Chamber of Commerce.

cands.gaps: No Tampa Bay Times endorsement found. Council votes not researched (per instructions); Tampa Rays stadium and mayoral-powers votes appear in recent Florida Politics coverage. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.
